zones.comment: the winner's door at the end of stage 3

author: Paper-Cut
notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own spawn, stage teleports and end doors (gb-maps-1). A race surf map in three stages, each ending in teleports to the next stage's start (stage2, stage3). Stage 3 ends in two doors side by side: one to the winners' platform with an AWP, which jails everybody else a second later, and one back to the top with a shotgun. The winner's door is the finish here; a track may have one finish, and the shotgun door beside it is the loser's way out. The teleports that start disabled are dropped (round_teleports): the stage 1 time limit (stage1_tojail, enabled 120 s after the spawn), the jail-everybody relay's teleports and the jail's exit. Not published.
